newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to announce PBK bank sale adviser on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Poland to announce PBK bank sale adviser on Monday.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry has chosen the privatisation adviser for the sale of the state-owned Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK), but will not announce it till Monday, Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said.
Kolodko told a news conference on Friday the announcement will be published in an official circular of the Public Procurement Office.
"The adviser had been chosen and will be announced in a bulletin of the Public Procurment Office on Monday," Kolodko said. @
PBK, one of the nine state-owned commercial banks spun off the central bank in 1989, is slated for sale in April 1997. It will be the fifth of the nine to be privatised.
In 1995 the bank had a capital of 527 million zlotys and a balance sheet total of 6.8 billion zlotys.
The finance ministry has signalled that it wanted to offer about 65 percent of the bank to a strategic investor or a group of investors.
